info.name: CYRUS API COLLECTION
info.description:
Welcome to CYRUS API Services.

Connectivity (Credentials)

Method accepts post or get data and will return JSON format data.
Please use below URLs for development purpose.

Credentials
The Credentials will be shared through E-mail.

Please make sure to choose Languages as HTTP on TOP.

Kindly follow the flow by :-

  1. API Key- API Panel> Setting>Active Services
  2. IP Whitelisting- API Panel> Setting> Whitelist IP
  3. Callback url- API Panel> Setting> Callback url

request.description:
number = Mobile no / Kno etc etc

memberid = Your API ID start with AP**

pin = Get from API Panel > Setting > Active services

operator = Use GetOperator Method and pass Operator code

circle = Use GetClrcle Method and****pass Circle code - Its required only for Prepaid and postpaid
Services for others keep it 1 (Circle=1)

usertx =
Pass System Generated ID (unique 10 alphanumeric ID)

othervalue = if any other value required to pass by that****operator

account = only need to pass Account no for BSNL / MTNL / Airtel
Broadband

RechargeMode = 1 // Pass 1 as Default route as Primary, Pass
2 for Secondary Route if Failed in primary route (not mandate)

description.content: // 1 For Primary API, 2 for Secondary API

query.description: // 1 For Primary API, 2 for Secondary API
// 1 For Primary API, 2 for Secondary API

request.description:
REQUEST PARAMETERS(HTTP GET METHOD)

?Status=&OperatorRef=&APITransID=&TransID=&ErrorCode=&Amount=

Status : SUCCESS/FAILED/FAILURE/REFUND OperatorRef : Operator Reference
APITransID : Cyrus Transaction ID
TransID : Your Transaction ID
ErrorCode : Error Message
Amount : Recharge Amount

Note:- Configure Callback Url from setting Callback

IF USER RECEIVED TXN IN STATUS CODE THEN KINDLY HIT SECOND METHOD SUBMITOTP(AFTER HITTING SUBMIT OTP IF REGISTRATION GET SUCCESS THEN USER WILL RECEIVE CALLBACK WITH UPIID)

IF USER RECEIVED ALR IN STATUSCODE THEN WILL GET CALLBACK WITH UPIID.(NO NEED TO HIT SUBMITOTP)

CALLBACK - YOURCALLBACK?OutLetID=123456&UPIID=ABC@ICICI&Type=UPI

request.description:
• Please download the sample app from the link which is provided, unzip the file and retrieve the sample project.
  • Import the sample project in android studio.
  • Fingpay folder will contain the aar file, if you are creating a new project then add this aar file as a new module and then add that module to project dependencies.
  • Some fields need to be sent to the sdk from the app, the code for this is already there in sample project. Following are the values to be sent to the SDK through intent.

intent.putExtra(Constants.MERCHANT_USERID, merchantId);

intent.putExtra(Constants.MERCHANT_PASSWORD, password);

intent.putExtra(Constants.AMOUNT, amount);

intent.putExtra(Constants.REMARKS, remarks);
intent.putExtra(Constants.MOBILE_NUMBER, mobile);
intent.putExtra(Constants.AMOUNT_EDITABLE, false);
intent.putExtra(Constants.TXN_ID, s);
intent.putExtra(Constants.SUPER_MERCHANTID, SUPER_MERCHANT_ID);

intent.putExtra(Constants.IMEI, imei);
intent.putExtra(Constants.LATITUDE, lat);
intent.putExtra(Constants.LONGITUDE, lng);

For CashWithdrawal:
intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.CASH_WITHDRAWAL);
For CashDeposit:
intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.CASH_DEPOSIT);
For Balance Enquiry

intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.BALANCE_ENQUIRY);
For MiniStatement
intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.MINI_STATEMENT);
For Pin Reset:
intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.PIN_RESET);

For PinChange:
intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.CHANGE_PIN);
For CardActivation: intent.putExtra(Constants.TYPE,Constants.CARD_ACTIVATION);

intent.putExtra(Constants.MICROATM_MANUFACTURER, Constants.MoreFun);

  • Following are the values to be sent to the SDK through intent for history.
intent.putExtra(Constants.MERCHANT_USERID, mId); 
 intent.putExtra(Constants.MERCHANT_PASSWORD, pswd); 
 intent.putExtra(Constants.SUPER_MERCHANTID, SUPER_MERCHANT_ID); 
 intent.putExtra(Constants.IMEI, imei);
  • SDK send back transaction status along with transaction Id to the app
    through intent in onActivityResult method. Code for this is available in
  • the sample project.

Please find the code below :

       boolean status = data.getBooleanExtra(Constants.TRANS_STATUS, false);


        String response = data.getStringExtra(Constants.MESSAGE);


        double transAmount = data.getDoubleExtra(Constants.TRANS_AMOUNT, 0);


        double balAmount = data.getDoubleExtra(Constants.BALANCE_AMOUNT, 0);


        String bankRrn = data.getStringExtra(Constants.RRN);


        String transType = data.getStringExtra(Constants.TRANS_TYPE);


        int type = data.getIntExtra(Constants.TYPE, Constants.CASH_WITHDRAWAL);

String cardNum =data.getStringExtra(Constants.CARD_NUM);

String bankName = data.getStringExtra(Constants.BANK_NAME);

String cardType = data.getStringExtra(Constants.CARD_TYPE);

String terminalId = data.getStringExtra(Constants.TERMINAL_ID);

String fpId = data.getStringExtra(Constants.FP_TRANS_ID);

String transId =data.getStringExtra(Constants.TRANS_ID);

In the build.gradle file, below dependencies need to be added along with the dependencies in the application.

repositories { maven { url 'https://oss.sonatype.org/content/repositories/ksoap2-android-releases/**' }

}**

}

request.description: The FARERULE API is used to retrieve the detailed fare rules and conditions applicable to the selected flight option. This API provides important information such as cancellation charges, rescheduling charges, refund policies, baggage allowances, and other fare-related restrictions defined by the airline. The fare rules returned by this API should be reviewed before proceeding with repricing and booking to ensure the selected flight meets the customer’s requirements.

request.description: The Air_Reprice API is used to revalidate and reprice the selected flight fare with the supplier before proceeding with the booking. This API ensures that the fare, availability, and other pricing components are still valid and up to date. The response returns the latest flight details with the repriced flag set to true, confirming whether the fare has changed or remains the same. This step is mandatory before booking to avoid fare mismatch or booking failures due to price changes.

request.description: The Air_GetSSR API is used to retrieve the list of available special service requests for the selected flight, such as meals, baggage, seat preferences, and other airline-specific services. This API must be called using the Flight_Key obtained from the Air_Reprice API response to ensure that the SSR information is fetched for the correct and latest priced flight. The response provides the complete list of optional and mandatory services that can be added before proceeding with seat selection and booking.

The AirSeatMaps API is used to retrieve the seat layout and available seat options for the selected flight segments. This API must be called using the Flight_Key obtained from the Air_Reprice API response to ensure that seat availability is fetched for the correct and latest priced flight. The response provides detailed seat information, including available, occupied, and chargeable seats, which allows the user to select preferred seats before proceeding with the booking.

request.description:
The Temp_Booking API is used to generate a temporary booking reference number using the provided passenger and flight details. This API must be called using the Flight_Key obtained from the Air_Reprice API response to ensure that the reference is generated for the correct and latest priced flight.

a)PAX Details

Name Type Description
Pax_Id Integer This requires the Pax id (1 based starting index)
Pax_type String This requires the PAX type 0-ADT/ 1-CHD/ 2-INF
Title String This requires the title
Adult - MR, MRS, MS
Child - MSTR, MISS
Infant - MSTR, MISS
FirstName String This requires the first name
LastName String This requires the last name
Gender String This requires the gender. Possible values 0/1 (0-Male, 1-Female)
Age String This requires the Age
DOB String This requires the DOB and the format should be MM/DD/YYYY format.
PassportNumber String This requires the Passport Number
PassportIssuingCountry String This requires the Passport Issuing Country
PassportExpiry String This requires the Passport Expiry and the format should be MM/DD/YYYY format.
Nationality String This requires the Nationality
FrequentFlyerDetails List(object) This requires list of Frequent Flyer Detail

b) Frequent Flyer Detail

Name Type Description
AirLineCode String This requires the AirLineCode
FrequentFlyerNumber String This requires the Frequent Flyer Number

c) Booking Flight Detail

Name Type Description
Search_Key String This requires flight journey search APIAirSearchRequest details as Key
Flight_Key String This requires the selected flight key from Air_Reprice
BookingSSRDetails List(Object) This requires list of Booking SSR Detail

d) Booking SSR Detail

Name Type Description
Pax_Id Integer This requires the pax id
SSR_Key String This requires the SSR key

request.description:
The Air_Ticketing_user API is used to confirm and commit the booking at the supplier or airline side and generate the final airline PNR. This API should be called after the temporary booking reference has been generated and payment has been completed successfully.

In some cases, the Air_Ticketing API may return an error with code "22-Failed". In such scenarios, the booking status must not be treated as failed immediately. Instead, the client must call the Air_Reprint API using the booking reference number to check the latest ticket status.

If the Ticket_Status_Id is 4, the booking status should be treated as Success. If the Ticket_Status_Id is 0, 2, 3, or 22, the booking status should be treated as InProcess and the booking status should be checked again after some time using the Air_Reprint API. For all other cases, the booking status should be treated as Failed.

response.name: Air_Ticketing_USER
Air_Ticketing_USER

request.description: The Air_Reprint API is used to retrieve the complete booking details for a given booking reference number or airline PNR. This API returns the full itinerary, passenger details, ticketing information, fare details, and current booking status. This API is commonly used to check the latest status of a booking, to display booking details to the customer, or to validate the final ticketing result after the Air_Ticketing_user process.

request.description:
Name Type Description
methodname String Air_TicketCancellation
RefNo String This requires Booking reference number.
ReqRemarks String This requires Request Remarks.
CancelCode String This object holds list of Air Ticket Cancellation Type
AirTicketCancelDetails List(object) This object holds list of Air Ticket Cancel Detail
CancellationType Integer 0-Normal Cancel, 1-Full Refund, 2-No Show

Cancellation Type and its Implementations

0-Normal Cancel: Online Cancellation - Selected Passengers and Sectors will be Auto cancelled with Applicable Penalty as per Airline.

1-Full Refund: Offline Cancellation - Selected Passengers and Sectors will be cancelled only if Full Refund is applicable.

2-No Show: Offline Cancellation.

a)AirTicketCancelDetail

Name Type Description
FlightId String This requires Flight Id Remarks.
PassengerId String This requires Passenger Id Remarks.
SegmentId String This requires Segment_Id Remarks.

b)AirTicketCancellationType

CancellationType CancelCode Description
0 015 Please cancel my ticket with Applicable Penalty
0 005 I cancelled the ticket directly with Airline
0 001 Other – Mentioned the reason in Request Remarks
CancellationType CancelCode Description
1 016 Flight Schedule Changed by Airline
1 005 I cancelled the ticket directly with Airline
1 004 Received a communication from Airline that Flight is not Operational
1 008 Flight Cancelled by the Airline
1 001 Other – Mentioned the reason in Request Remarks
CancellationType CancelCode Description
2 011 Claim No Show Tax Refund
2 001 Other – Mentioned the reason in Request Remarks

This API fetches the cancellation penaty value passenger wise for the cancellation request initiated. Also this API will provide the Split PNR Details.

Request Object - AirGetCancelPenalty

AirGetCancelPenaltyRequest

Name Type Description
Booking_RefNo String This requires Booking reference number.
Airline_PNR String Airline PNR Number is given.
CancelReqId Integer Cancel Request Id is given.

Response Object-AirGetCancelPenaltyResponse

APIAirGetCancelPenaltyResponse

Name Type Description
CancelChargeDetails Object Cancel Charge Details is available
CancelReqDetails Object Cancel Request Details is available

a) CancelCharge Details

Name Type Description
CancelReqId Integer Cancel Request Id is given.
CancelSegmentDetails Object Cancel Segment Details given
CancellationCharges Integer Cancellation Charges given
PaxId Integer Pax Id cancelled is given
Pax_Name String Pax Name cancelled is given
TicketFare Integer TicketFare Value is given

b) CancelReqDetails

Name Type Description
CancelReqId Integer Cancel Request Id is given.
CancelStatus String Cancellation Status is given
IsSplitPNR Boolean True, if PNR is split.
RefundedDT String Refund Date is given
RequestedDT String Requested Date is given
SplitPNR String SplitPNR details is given
